stalenessRule: Any material change to the later admitted authorizedBase, any of the nine canonical source blobs, CORE-WO-M04-001, or governing GEF policy makes an active M04 lock STALE and blocks execution until governed re-admission.
promotionRule: CORE-M04-FREEZE-001 may promote this planning lock as frozen metadata only. It remains non-authoritative until a separate CORE-M04-ADMIT-001-equivalent delta binds a concrete authorizedBase, recompiles current canonical source fingerprints, activates the lock, and is independently reviewed/promoted to canonical origin/main.
activationRule: Implementation is forbidden while status is PENDING_PROMOTION or authorizedBase is null. A later admission PR branch does not authorize execution by itself; authorization becomes effective only after its exact reviewed state is promoted to canonical origin/main.
executionStartRule: After separate admission promotion, create feat/m04-run-state from the admitted post-promotion canonical origin/main, prove the authorized final-freeze base is an ancestor with only governed admission/synchronization metadata between them, then repeat Git/HIVE/governance preflight before Pack A.
